title.zh: 新唐書卷四十三上 志第三十三上 地理七

sentences.zh: 嶺南道嶺南道，蓋古揚州之南境，漢南海、鬱林、蒼梧、珠崖、儋耳、交趾、合浦、九真、日南等郡。

translations.literal: Lingnan Circuit: Lingnan Circuit broadly comprised the southern reaches of ancient Yangzhou—the Han commanderies of Nanhai, Yulin, Cangwu, Zhuya, Dan'er, Jiaozhi, Hepu, Jiuzhen, Rinan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan Circuit covered what had been the southern borderlands of ancient Yangzhou, corresponding to the Han-era commanderies of Nanhai, Yulin, Cangwu, Zhuya, Dan'er, Jiaozhi, Hepu, Jiuzhen, Rinan, and the like.

sentences.zh: 韶、廣、康、端、封、梧、藤、羅、雷、崖以東為星紀分，桂、柳、鬱林、富、昭、蒙、龔、繡、容、白、羅而西及安南為鶉尾分。

translations.literal: Shao, Guang, Kang, Duan, Feng, Wu, Teng, Luo, Lei, and Ya eastward belonged to the Xingji astronomical allotment; Gui, Liu, Yulin, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, Luo westward and Annam belonged to the Chunwei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: East of Shao, Guang, Kang, Duan, Feng, Wu, Teng, Luo, Lei, and Ya lay the Xingji zodiacal division; Gui, Liu, Yulin, Fu, Zhao, Meng, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, Luo to the west and Annam fell within the Chunwei division.

sentences.zh: 為州七十有三，都護府一，縣三百一十四。

translations.literal: There were seventy-three prefectures, one protectorate-general, and three hundred fourteen counties.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit comprised seventy-three prefectures, one protectorate-general, and three hundred fourteen counties.

translations.literal: Its famous mountains: Huangling and Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Notable mountains included Huangling and Lingzhou.

translations.literal: Its great rivers: Gui and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: The principal rivers were the Gui and Yu.

sentences.zh: 厥賦：蕉、紵、落麻、厥貢：金、銀、孔翠、犀、象、綵藤、竹布。

translations.literal: Its tax-in-kind: plantain, ramie, and decorticated hemp; its tribute: gold, silver, kingfisher feathers, rhinoceros horn, ivory, colored rattan, and bamboo cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Tax payments included plantain fiber, ramie, and hemp; tribute items comprised gold, silver, kingfisher plumes, rhinoceros horn, ivory, dyed rattan, and bamboo cloth.

sentences.zh: 廣州廣州南海郡，中都督府。

translations.literal: Guangzhou, Guangzhou, Nanhai Commandery—a mid-level area military command prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guang Prefecture (Guangzhou), Nanhai Commandery: a mid-level area military command prefecture.

sentences.zh: 土貢：銀、藤簟、竹席、荔支、鼊皮、鼈甲、蚺蛇膽、石斛、沈香、甲香、詹糖香。

translations.literal: Local tribute: silver, rattan mats, bamboo mats, litchi, softshell-turtle hide, turtle shell, python gall, dendrobium, agarwood, shell incense, sandalwood sugar.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute from the region included silver, rattan mats, bamboo mats, litchi, softshell-turtle hide, turtle shell, python gall, dendrobium, agarwood, shell incense, sandalwood sugar.

sentences.zh: 山峻水深，民不井汲，都督劉巨麟始鑿井四。

translations.literal: Frontier-administered prefectures
translations.idiomatic: Frontier-administered prefectures

sentences.zh: 唐興，初未暇於四夷，自太宗平突厥，西北諸蕃及蠻夷稍稍內屬，卽其部落列置州縣。

translations.literal: When Tang arose, at first it had no leisure for the four barbarians; after Taizong pacified the Turks, the northwestern tribes and Man and Yi gradually submitted and were attached, and their tribes were immediately listed as prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang arose it first had no leisure for the four quarters; after Taizong pacified the Turks, northwestern tribes and Man and Yi gradually submitted, and their tribes were immediately registered as prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 其大者為都督府，以其首領為都督、刺史，皆得世襲。

translations.literal: The larger ones became area commands; their chieftains were made area commanders and prefects, all inheritable.
translations.idiomatic: The larger groups became area commands; their chieftains were made area commanders and prefects, all with hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 雖貢賦版籍，多不上戶部，然聲教所暨，皆邊州都督、都護所領，著于令式。

translations.literal: Although tribute and household registers often were not reported to the Ministry of Revenue, wherever imperial instruction reached, all were governed by frontier prefects and protector-generals, as set forth in statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Although tribute and household registers often were not reported to the Ministry of Revenue, wherever imperial instruction reached was governed by frontier prefects and protector-generals, as set forth in statutes.

sentences.zh: 今錄招降開置之目，以見其盛。

translations.literal: Now the list of those pacified, submitted, and opened is recorded to show their extent.
translations.idiomatic: The list of those pacified, submitted, and opened is recorded here to show their extent.

sentences.zh: 其後或臣或叛，經制不一，不能詳見。

translations.literal: Thereafter some submitted and some rebelled; regulation was not uniform and cannot be fully detailed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter some submitted and some rebelled; regulation was not uniform and cannot be fully detailed.

sentences.zh: 突厥、回紇、党項、吐谷渾隸關內道者，為府二十九，州九十。

translations.literal: Turks, Uyghurs, Tangut, and Tuyuhun subordinate to the Guannei circuit: twenty-nine area commands and ninety prefectures.

sentences.zh: 突厥之別部及奚、契丹、靺鞨、降胡、高麗隸河北者，為府十四，州四十六。

translations.literal: Other divisions of the Turks and of Xi, Khitan, Mohe, surrendered Hu, and Koguryo subordinate to Hebei: fourteen area commands and forty-six prefectures.

sentences.zh: 突厥、回紇、党項、吐谷渾之別部及龜茲、于闐、焉耆、疏勒、河西內屬諸胡、西域十六國隸隴右者，為府五十一，州百九十八。

sentences.zh: 羌、蠻隸劍南者，為州二百六十一。

translations.literal: The seven most important routes into the Four Yi and their key passes and mustering points are: first, the Yingzhou route into the Andong circuit; second, the Dengzhou sea route into Goryeo and Bohai; third, the Xiazhou outer route through the Tongda Yunzhong route; fourth, the Middle Accepted-Submission City route into the Uyghurs; fifth, the Anxi route into the Western Regions; sixth, the Annan route into India; seventh, the Guangzhou route through the sea to the maritime Yi.

translations.idiomatic: One hundred eighty li east of Ying Prefecture one reaches Yancheng.

sentences.zh: 又經汝羅守捉，渡遼水至安東都護府五百里。

translations.literal: Passing also through the Ruoluo garrison and crossing the Liao River, it is five hundred li to the Andong Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Passing also through the Ruoluo garrison and crossing the Liao River, it is five hundred li to the Andong Protectorate.

translations.literal: The seat is the former Han Xiangping city.
translations.idiomatic: The seat is the former Han Xiangping city.

translations.literal: Southeast to Pyongyang city is eight hundred li;
translations.idiomatic: Southeast to Pyongyang city is eight hundred li;

sentences.zh: 西南至都里海口六百里；

translations.literal: southwest to Duli Harbor is six hundred li;
translations.idiomatic: southwest to Duli Harbor is six hundred li;

sentences.zh: 西至建安城三百里，故中郭縣也；

translations.literal: west to Jian'an city is three hundred li—the former Zhongguo county;
translations.idiomatic: west to Jian'an city is three hundred li—the former Zhongguo county;

sentences.zh: 南至鴨淥江北泊汋城七百里，故安平縣也。

translations.literal: south to the north bank of the Yalu River at Zhuocheng is seven hundred li—the former Anping county.
translations.idiomatic: south to the north bank of the Yalu River at Zhuocheng is seven hundred li—the former Anping county.

sentences.zh: 自都護府東北經古蓋牟、新城，又經渤海長嶺府，千五百里至渤海王城，城臨忽汗海，其西南三十里有古肅慎城，其北經德理鎮，至南黑水靺鞨千里。

translations.literal: From the protectorate northeast through ancient Gaimou and Xincheng, and again through Bohai's Changling prefecture, it is one thousand five hundred li to the Bohai royal city; the city faces the Huhai Sea, and thirty li southwest is the ancient Sushen city; north through Deli Post it is one thousand li to the southern Heishui Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: From the protectorate northeast through ancient Gaimou and Xincheng, and again through Bohai's Changling prefecture, it is one thousand five hundred li to the Bohai royal city; the city faces the Huhai Sea, and thirty li southwest is the ancient Sushen city; north through Deli Post it is one thousand li to the southern Heishui Mohe.

sentences.zh: 登州東北海行，過大謝島、龜歆島、末島、烏湖島三百里。

translations.literal: From Deng Prefecture northeast by sea, passing Great Xie Island, Guixin Island, Mo Island, and Wuhu Island is three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: From Deng Prefecture northeast by sea, passing Great Xie Island, Guixin Island, Mo Island, and Wuhu Island is three hundred li.

sentences.zh: 北渡烏湖海，至馬石山東之都里鎮二百里。

translations.literal: Crossing north over the Wuhu Sea, to Duli Town east of Mashi Mountain is two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing north over the Wuhu Sea, to Duli Town east of Mashi Mountain is two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 東傍海壖，過青泥浦、桃花浦、杏花浦、石人汪、橐駝灣、烏骨江八百里。

translations.literal: Following the coastal rim east, passing Qingnipo, Taohuapo, Xinghuapo, Shirenwang, Tuotuowan, and Wugu River is eight hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Following the coastal rim east, passing Qingnipo, Taohuapo, Xinghuapo, Shirenwang, Tuotuowan, and Wugu River is eight hundred li.

sentences.zh: 乃南傍海壖，過烏牧島、貝江口、椒島，得新羅西北之長口鎮。

translations.literal: Then south along the coastal rim, passing Wumu Island, Beijiangkou, and Jiaodao, one reaches Changkou Town in northwest Silla.
translations.idiomatic: Then south along the coastal rim, passing Wumu Island, Beijiangkou, and Jiaodao, one reaches Changkou Town in northwest Silla.

sentences.zh: 又過秦王石橋、麻田島、古寺島、得物島，千里至鴨淥江唐恩浦口。

translations.literal: Passing again Qinwang Stone Bridge, Matian Island, and Gusi Island, and Dewu Island, it is one thousand li to Tang'en Ford on the Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: Passing again Qinwang Stone Bridge, Matian Island, Gusi Island, and Dewu Island, it is one thousand li to Tang'en Ford on the Yalu River.

sentences.zh: 乃東南陸行，七百里至新羅王城。

translations.literal: Then overland southeast, seven hundred li to the Silla royal city.
translations.idiomatic: Then overland southeast, seven hundred li to the Silla royal city.

sentences.zh: 自鴨淥江口舟行百餘里，乃小舫泝流東北三十里至泊汋口，得渤海之境。

translations.literal: From the Yalu River mouth by boat a hundred-odd li, then by small craft upstream northeast thirty li to Zhuokou, reaching Bohai territory.
translations.idiomatic: From the Yalu River mouth by boat a hundred-odd li, then by small craft upstream northeast thirty li to Zhuokou, reaching Bohai territory.

sentences.zh: 又泝流五百里，至丸都縣城，故高麗王都。

translations.literal: Again upstream five hundred li to Wandu County city—the former Goryeo royal capital.
translations.idiomatic: Again upstream five hundred li to Wandu County city—the former Goryeo royal capital.

sentences.zh: 又東北泝流二百里，至神州。

translations.literal: Again upstream northeast two hundred li to Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Again upstream northeast two hundred li to Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 又陸行四百里，至顯州，天寶中王所都。

translations.literal: Again overland four hundred li to Xian Prefecture—the Tianbao-era royal seat.
translations.idiomatic: Again overland four hundred li to Xian Prefecture—the Tianbao-era royal seat.

sentences.zh: 又正北如東六百里，至渤海王城。

translations.literal: Again due north like east six hundred li to the Bohai royal city.
translations.idiomatic: Again due north like east six hundred li to the Bohai royal city.

sentences.zh: 夏州北渡烏水，經賀麟澤、拔利干澤，過沙，次內橫剗、沃野泊、長澤、白城，百二十里至可朱渾水源。

translations.literal: From Xia Prefecture crossing north over the Wu River, passing Helin Marsh, Baligan Marsh, then sand, next Neihengchua, Woye Marsh, Changze, and Baicheng, one hundred twenty li to the Kezhuhun River source.
translations.idiomatic: From Xia Prefecture crossing north over the Wu River, passing Helin Marsh, Baligan Marsh, then sand, next Neihengchua, Woye Marsh, Changze, and Baicheng, one hundred twenty li to the Kezhuhun River source.

sentences.zh: 又經故陽城澤、橫剗北門、突紇利泊、石子嶺，百餘里至阿頹泉。

translations.literal: Again passing the former Yangcheng Marsh, Hengchua North Gate, Tuoheli Marsh, and Shiziling, a hundred-odd li to A'ui Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing the former Yangcheng Marsh, Hengchua North Gate, Tuoheli Marsh, and Shiziling, a hundred-odd li to A'ui Spring.

sentences.zh: 又經大非苦鹽池，六十六里至賀蘭驛。

translations.literal: Again passing the Great Feiku Salt Lake, sixty-six li to Helan Post.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing the Great Feiku Salt Lake, sixty-six li to Helan Post.

sentences.zh: 又經庫也干泊、彌鵝泊、榆祿渾泊，百餘里至地頹澤。

translations.literal: Again passing Kuye Marsh, Miyu Marsh, and Yuluhun Marsh, a hundred-odd li to Ditu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Kuye Marsh, Miyu Marsh, and Yuluhun Marsh, a hundred-odd li to Ditu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 又經步拙泉故城，八十八里渡烏那水，經胡洛鹽池、紇伏干泉，四十八里度庫結沙，一曰普納沙，二十八里過橫水，五十九里至十賁故城，又十里至寧遠鎮。

translations.literal: Again passing Bozhuo Spring old city, eighty-eight li crossing the Wuna River, passing Huluo Salt Lake and Hewogan Spring, forty-eight li crossing Kujie Sand—also called Punasha—twenty-eight li crossing Hengshui, fifty-nine li to Shiben old city, and again ten li to Ningyuan Post.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Bozhuo Spring old city, eighty-eight li crossing the Wuna River, passing Huluo Salt Lake and Hewogan Spring, forty-eight li crossing Kujie Sand—also called Punasha—twenty-eight li crossing Hengshui, fifty-nine li to Shiben old city, and again ten li to Ningyuan Post.

sentences.zh: 又涉屯根水，五十里至安樂戍，戍在河西壖，其東壖有古大同城。

translations.literal: Again crossing Tungen River, fifty li to Anle Garrison; the garrison is on the west riverbank, and on the east bank is the ancient Datong city.
translations.idiomatic: Again crossing Tungen River, fifty li to Anle Garrison; the garrison is on the west riverbank, and on the east bank is the ancient Datong city.

translations.literal: The present Datong city is the former Yongji Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The present Datong city is the former Yongji Stockade.

sentences.zh: 北經大泊，十七里至金河。

translations.literal: North through Great Marsh, seventeen li to the Jin River.
translations.idiomatic: North through Great Marsh, seventeen li to the Jin River.

sentences.zh: 又經故後魏沃野鎮城，傍金河，過古長城，九十二里至吐俱麟川。

translations.literal: Again passing the former Later Wei Woye Garrison city beside the Jin River, crossing the ancient Great Wall, ninety-two li to Tujulin River.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing the former Later Wei Woye Garrison city beside the Jin River, crossing the ancient Great Wall, ninety-two li to Tujulin River.

sentences.zh: 傍水行，經破落汗山、賀悅泉，百三十一里至步越多山。

translations.literal: Following the water, passing Poluohan Mountain and Heyue Spring, one hundred thirty-one li to Bujiduo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Following the water, passing Poluohan Mountain and Heyue Spring, one hundred thirty-one li to Bujiduo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又東北二十里至纈特泉。

translations.literal: Again northeast twenty li to Xiete Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Again northeast twenty li to Xiete Spring.

sentences.zh: 又東六十里至賀人山，山西磧口有詰特犍泊。

translations.literal: Again east sixty li to Heren Mountain; on the mountain's west gravel pass is Jietejian Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Again east sixty li to Heren Mountain; on the mountain's west gravel pass is Jietejian Marsh.

sentences.zh: 吐俱麟川水西有城，城東南經拔厥那山，二百三十里至帝割達城。

translations.literal: West of Tujulin River water is a city; southeast from the city passing Bajiena Mountain is two hundred thirty li to Digeda City.
translations.idiomatic: West of Tujulin River water is a city; southeast from the city passing Bajiena Mountain is two hundred thirty li to Digeda City.

translations.literal: Again northeast to Nuozhen River fork.
translations.idiomatic: Again northeast to Nuozhen River fork.

sentences.zh: 又東南百八十七里，經古可汗城至鹹澤。

translations.literal: Again southeast one hundred eighty-seven li, passing the ancient Kehan city to Xian Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Again southeast one hundred eighty-seven li, passing the ancient Kehan city to Xian Marsh.

sentences.zh: 又東南經烏咄谷，二百七里至古雲中城。

translations.literal: Again southeast passing Wudugu, two hundred seven li to the ancient Yunzhong city.
translations.idiomatic: Again southeast passing Wudugu, two hundred seven li to the ancient Yunzhong city.

sentences.zh: 又西五十五里有綏遠城。

translations.literal: Again west fifty-five li is Suiyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: Again west fifty-five li is Suiyuan city.

translations.literal: All are tribal settlements north of Ling and Xia.
translations.idiomatic: All are tribal settlements north of Ling and Xia.

sentences.zh: 中受降城正北如東八十里，有呼延谷，谷南口有呼延柵，谷北口有歸唐柵，車道也，入回鶻使所經。

translations.literal: From Middle Accepted-Submission City due north like east eighty li is Huyan Valley; at the valley's south mouth is Huyan Stockade, at the north mouth is Guitang Stockade—a cart road used by envoys to the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: From Middle Accepted-Submission City due north like east eighty li is Huyan Valley; at the valley's south mouth is Huyan Stockade, at the north mouth is Guitang Stockade—a cart road used by envoys to the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 又五百里至鷿鵜泉，又十里入磧，經麚鹿山、鹿耳山、錯甲山，八百里至山鷰子井。

translations.literal: Again five hundred li to Pilu Spring, again ten li entering gravel, passing Milu Mountain, Lu'er Mountain, and Cuojia Mountain, eight hundred li to Shanyanzi Well.
translations.idiomatic: Again five hundred li to Pilu Spring, again ten li entering gravel, passing Milu Mountain, Lu'er Mountain, and Cuojia Mountain, eight hundred li to Shanyanzi Well.

sentences.zh: 又西北經密粟山、達旦泊、野馬泊、可汗泉、橫嶺、綿泉、鏡泊，七百里至回鶻衙帳。

translations.literal: Again northwest passing Mimi Mountain, Dada Marsh, Yema Marsh, Kehan Spring, Hengling, Mian Spring, and Jing Marsh, seven hundred li to the Uyghur yurt.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest passing Mimi Mountain, Dada Marsh, Yema Marsh, Kehan Spring, Hengling, Mian Spring, and Jing Marsh, seven hundred li to the Uyghur yurt.

sentences.zh: 又別道自鷿鵜泉北經公主城、眉間城、怛羅思山、赤崖、鹽泊、渾義河、爐門山、木燭嶺，千五百里亦至回鶻衙帳。

translations.literal: Another route from north of Pilu Spring passes Princess City, Meijian City, Taluosi Mountain, Chiya, Salt Marsh, Hunyi River, and Mulao Ridge; one thousand five hundred li also reaches the Uyghur yurt.
translations.idiomatic: Another route from north of Pilu Spring passes Princess City, Meijian City, Taluosi Mountain, Chiya, Salt Marsh, Hunyi River, and Mulao Ridge; one thousand five hundred li also reaches the Uyghur yurt.

sentences.zh: 東有平野，西據烏德鞬山，南依嗢昆水，北六七百里至仙娥河，河北岸有富貴城。

translations.literal: To the east is open plain; to the west it rests on Wudejian Mountain; to the south it relies on Wokun River; north six or seven hundred li to Xian'e River, and on the river's north bank is Fugui City.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is open plain; to the west it rests on Wudejian Mountain; to the south it relies on Wokun River; north six or seven hundred li to Xian'e River, and on the river's north bank is Fugui City.

sentences.zh: 又正北如東過雪山松樺林及諸泉泊，千五百里至骨利幹，又西十三日行至都播部落，又北六七日至堅昆部落，有牢山、劍水。

translations.literal: Again due north like east, passing Snow Mountain pine-fir forest and various spring marshes, one thousand five hundred li to Guligan; again west thirteen days' travel to the Dubo tribe; again north six or seven days to the Jian Kun tribe, which has Lao Mountain and Sword River.
translations.idiomatic: Again due north like east, passing Snow Mountain pine-fir forest and various spring marshes, one thousand five hundred li to Guligan; again west thirteen days' travel to the Dubo tribe; again north six or seven days to the Jian Kun tribe, which has Lao Mountain and Sword River.

sentences.zh: 又自衙帳東北渡仙娥河，二千里至室韋。

translations.literal: Again from the yurt northeast crossing Xian'e River, two thousand li to the Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Again from the yurt northeast crossing Xian'e River, two thousand li to the Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 骨利幹之東，室韋之西有鞠部落，亦曰祴部落。

translations.literal: East of Guligan and west of the Shiwei is the Ju tribe, also called the Gai tribe.
translations.idiomatic: East of Guligan and west of the Shiwei is the Ju tribe, also called the Gai tribe.

sentences.zh: 其東十五日行有俞折國，亦室韋部落。

translations.literal: Fifteen days' travel east is the Yuzhe kingdom, also a Shiwei tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen days' travel east is the Yuzhe kingdom, also a Shiwei tribe.

sentences.zh: 又正北十日行有大漢國，又北有骨師國。

translations.literal: Again due north ten days' travel is the Dahan kingdom; again north is the Gushi kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again due north ten days' travel is the Dahan kingdom; again north is the Gushi kingdom.

sentences.zh: 骨利幹、都播二部落北有小海，冰堅時馬行八日可度。

translations.literal: North of Guligan and Dubo tribes is a small sea; when the ice is firm horses can cross in eight days.
translations.idiomatic: North of Guligan and Dubo tribes is a small sea; when the ice is firm horses can cross in eight days.

sentences.zh: 海北多大山，其民狀貌甚偉，風俗類骨利幹，晝長而夕短。

translations.literal: North of the sea are many great mountains; the people are very tall in appearance and their customs resemble Guligan; the day is long and the evening short.
translations.idiomatic: North of the sea are many great mountains; the people are very tall in appearance and their customs resemble Guligan; the day is long and the evening short.

sentences.zh: 回鶻有延姪伽水，一曰延特勒泊，曰延特勒郍海。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs have Yanzhi River—also called Yantele Marsh, also called Yantele Sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs have Yanzhi River—also called Yantele Marsh, also called Yantele Sea.

sentences.zh: 烏德鞬山左右嗢昆河、獨邏河皆屈曲東北流，至衙帳東北五百里合流。

translations.literal: East and west of Wudejian Mountain the Wokun and Duluo rivers both wind northeast; five hundred li northeast of the yurt they join.
translations.idiomatic: East and west of Wudejian Mountain the Wokun and Duluo rivers both wind northeast; five hundred li northeast of the yurt they join.

sentences.zh: 泊東北千餘里有俱倫泊，泊之四面皆室韋。

translations.literal: More than one thousand li northeast of the marsh is Julun Marsh; on all four sides of the marsh are Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: More than one thousand li northeast of the marsh is Julun Marsh; on all four sides of the marsh are Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 安西西出柘厥關，渡白馬河，百八十里西入俱毗羅磧。

translations.literal: From Anxi west out of Zhejue Pass, crossing White Horse River, one hundred eighty li west enters the Jubiluo gravel desert.
translations.idiomatic: From Anxi west out of Zhejue Pass, crossing White Horse River, one hundred eighty li west enters the Jubiluo gravel desert.

sentences.zh: 經苦井，百二十里至俱毗羅城。

translations.literal: Passing Kujing, one hundred twenty li to Jubiluo city.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Kujing, one hundred twenty li to Jubiluo city.

translations.literal: Again sixty li to Axiyan city.
translations.idiomatic: Again sixty li to Axiyan city.

sentences.zh: 又六十里至撥換城，一曰威戎城，曰姑墨州，南臨思渾河。

translations.literal: Again sixty li to Bohuan city—also called Weirong city, also called Gumo Prefecture; south it faces the Sihun River.
translations.idiomatic: Again sixty li to Bohuan city—also called Weirong city, also called Gumo Prefecture; south it faces the Sihun River.

sentences.zh: 乃西北渡撥換河、中河，距思渾河百二十里，至小石城。

translations.literal: Then northwest crossing Bohuan River and Zhonghe, one hundred twenty li from the Sihun River to Xiaoshi city.
translations.idiomatic: Then northwest crossing Bohuan River and Zhonghe, one hundred twenty li from the Sihun River to Xiaoshi city.

sentences.zh: 又二十里至于闐境之胡蘆河。

translations.literal: Again twenty li to Khotan territory's Huluh River.
translations.idiomatic: Again twenty li to Khotan territory's Huluh River.

sentences.zh: 又六十里至大石城，一曰于祝，曰溫肅州。

translations.literal: Again sixty li to Dashi city—also called Yuzhu, also called Wensu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Again sixty li to Dashi city—also called Yuzhu, also called Wensu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又西北三十里至粟樓烽。

translations.literal: Again northwest thirty li to Suilou Beacon.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest thirty li to Suilou Beacon.

translations.literal: Again forty li crossing Badaling.
translations.idiomatic: Again forty li crossing Badaling.

sentences.zh: 又五十里至頓多城，烏孫所治赤山城也。

translations.literal: Again fifty li to Duoduo city—the Chishan city where the Wusun ruled.
translations.idiomatic: Again fifty li to Duoduo city—the Chishan city where the Wusun ruled.

sentences.zh: 又三十里渡真珠河，又西北度乏驛嶺，五十里渡雪海，又三十里至碎卜戍，傍碎卜水五十里至熱海。

translations.literal: Again thirty li crossing Zhenzhu River, again northwest crossing Fazha Ridge, fifty li crossing Xuehai, again thirty li to Suibo Garrison; beside Suibo water fifty li to Rehai.
translations.idiomatic: Again thirty li crossing Zhenzhu River, again northwest crossing Fazha Ridge, fifty li crossing Xuehai, again thirty li to Suibo Garrison; beside Suibo water fifty li to Rehai.

sentences.zh: 又四十里至凍城，又百一十里至賀獵城，又三十里至葉支城，出谷至碎葉川口，八十里至裴羅將軍城。

translations.literal: Again forty li to Dongcheng, again one hundred ten li to Helie city, again thirty li to Yezhi city; exiting the valley to Suyab River mouth, eighty li to Peiluo General's city.
translations.idiomatic: Again forty li to Dongcheng, again one hundred ten li to Helie city, again thirty li to Yezhi city; exiting the valley to Suyab River mouth, eighty li to Peiluo General's city.

sentences.zh: 又西二十里至碎葉城，城北有碎葉水，水北四十里有羯丹山，十姓可汗每立君長於此。

translations.literal: Again west twenty li to Suyab city; north of the city is Suyab water; forty li north of the water is Jiedan Mountain, where the Ten-Surname qaghan each enthroned a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Again west twenty li to Suyab city; north of the city is Suyab water; forty li north of the water is Jiedan Mountain, where the Ten-Surname qaghan each enthroned a ruler.

sentences.zh: 自碎葉西十里至米國城，又三十里至新城，又六十里至頓建城，又五十里至阿史不來城，又七十里至俱蘭城，又十里至稅建城，又五十里至怛羅斯城。

translations.literal: From Suyab west ten li to Miguo city, again thirty li to Xincheng, again sixty li to Dunjian city, again fifty li to Ashibulai city, again seventy li to Julan city, again ten li to Shuijian city, again fifty li to Taluosi city.
translations.idiomatic: From Suyab west ten li to Miguo city, again thirty li to Xincheng, again sixty li to Dunjian city, again fifty li to Ashibulai city, again seventy li to Julan city, again ten li to Shuijian city, again fifty li to Taluosi city.

sentences.zh: 自撥換、碎葉西南渡渾河，百八十里有濟濁館，故和平鋪也。

translations.literal: From Bohuan and Suyab southwest crossing the Hun River, one hundred eighty li is Jizhuo Post—the former Heping post station.
translations.idiomatic: From Bohuan and Suyab southwest crossing the Hun River, one hundred eighty li is Jizhuo Post—the former Heping post station.

sentences.zh: 又經故達幹城，百二十里至謁者館。

translations.literal: Again passing former Dagan city, one hundred twenty li to Yezhe Post.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing former Dagan city, one hundred twenty li to Yezhe Post.

sentences.zh: 又六十里至據史德城，龜茲境也，一曰鬱頭州，在赤河北岸孤石山。

translations.literal: Again sixty li to Jushide city—Kucha territory; also called Yutou Prefecture, on Ghe River's north bank at Gushi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Again sixty li to Jushide city—Kucha territory; also called Yutou Prefecture, on Ghe River's north bank at Gushi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 渡赤河，經岐山，三百四十里至葭蘆館。

translations.literal: Crossing Chi River, passing Qishan, three hundred forty li to Jialu Post.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Chi River, passing Qishan, three hundred forty li to Jialu Post.

sentences.zh: 又經達漫城，百四十里至疏勒鎮，南北西三面皆有山，城在水中。

translations.literal: Again passing Daman city, one hundred forty li to Shule garrison; north, south, and west all have mountains, and the city stands in the water.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Daman city, one hundred forty li to Shule garrison; north, south, and west all have mountains, and the city stands in the water.

sentences.zh: 城東又有漢城，亦在灘上。

translations.literal: East of the city is also a Han city, likewise on the shoals.
translations.idiomatic: East of the city is also a Han city, likewise on the shoals.

sentences.zh: 赤河來自疏勒西葛羅嶺，至城西分流，合于城東北，入據史德界。

translations.literal: Chi River comes from Geluo Ridge west of Shule; at the city's west it divides, joining east-northeast of the city and entering Jushide territory.
translations.idiomatic: Chi River comes from Geluo Ridge west of Shule; at the city's west it divides, joining east-northeast of the city and entering Jushide territory.

sentences.zh: 自撥換南而東，經崑崗，渡赤河，又西南經神山、睢陽、鹹泊，又南經疎樹，九百三十里至于闐鎮城。

translations.literal: From Bohuan south and east, passing Kunlun, crossing Chi River, again southwest passing Shenshan, Suiyang, and Xianbo, again south passing Shushu, nine hundred thirty li to Khotan garrison city.
translations.idiomatic: From Bohuan south and east, passing Kunlun, crossing Chi River, again southwest passing Shenshan, Suiyang, and Xianbo, again south passing Shushu, nine hundred thirty li to Khotan garrison city.

sentences.zh: 于闐西五十里有葦關，又西經勃野，西北渡繫館河，六百二十里至郅支滿城，一曰磧南州。

translations.literal: Fifty li west of Khotan is Weiguan; again west passing Boye, northwest crossing Xiguan River, six hundred twenty li to Zhijimancheng—also called Qinan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty li west of Khotan is Weiguan; again west passing Boye, northwest crossing Xiguan River, six hundred twenty li to Zhijimancheng—also called Qinan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又西北經苦井、黃渠，三百二十里至雙渠，故羯飯館也。

translations.literal: Again northwest passing Kujing and Huangqu, three hundred twenty li to Shuangqu—the former Jiefan post station.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest passing Kujing and Huangqu, three hundred twenty li to Shuangqu—the former Jiefan post station.

sentences.zh: 又西北經半城，百六十里至演渡州，又北八十里至疏勒鎮。

translations.literal: Again northwest passing Bancheng, one hundred sixty li to Yandu Prefecture, again north eighty li to Shule garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest passing Bancheng, one hundred sixty li to Yandu Prefecture, again north eighty li to Shule garrison.

sentences.zh: 自疏勒西南入劍末谷、青山嶺、青嶺、不忍嶺，六百里至葱嶺守捉，故羯盤陀國，開元中置守捉，安西極邊之戍。

translations.literal: From Shule southwest entering Jianmogu, Qingshan Ridge, Qingling, and Buren Ridge, six hundred li to Congling garrison—the former Jiankuotuo kingdom; a garrison established in the Kaiyuan era, the Anxi frontier's outermost post.
translations.idiomatic: From Shule southwest entering Jianmogu, Qingshan Ridge, Qingling, and Buren Ridge, six hundred li to Congling garrison—the former Jiankuotuo kingdom; a garrison established in the Kaiyuan era, the Anxi frontier's outermost post.

sentences.zh: 有寧彌故城，一曰達德力城，曰汗彌國，曰拘彌城。

translations.literal: There is Ningmi old city—also called Dadeli city, also called Hanmi kingdom, also called Jumi city.
translations.idiomatic: There is Ningmi old city—also called Dadeli city, also called Hanmi kingdom, also called Jumi city.

sentences.zh: 于闐東三百九十里，有建德力河，東七百里有精絕國。

translations.literal: Three hundred ninety li east of Khotan is Jiandeli River; seven hundred li east is the Jingjue kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred ninety li east of Khotan is Jiandeli River; seven hundred li east is the Jingjue kingdom.

sentences.zh: 于闐西南三百八十里，有皮山城，北與姑墨接。

translations.literal: Three hundred eighty li southwest of Khotan is Pishan city, bordering Gumo to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred eighty li southwest of Khotan is Pishan city, bordering Gumo to the north.

sentences.zh: 凍凌山在于闐國西南七百里。

translations.literal: Dongling Mountain is seven hundred li southwest of the Khotan kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Dongling Mountain is seven hundred li southwest of the Khotan kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又于闐東三百里有坎城鎮，東六百里有蘭城鎮，南六百里有胡弩鎮，西二百里有固城鎮，西三百九十里有吉良鎮。

translations.literal: Again three hundred li east of Khotan is Kancheng garrison; six hundred li east is Lancheng garrison; six hundred li south is Hunu garrison; two hundred li west is Gucheng garrison; three hundred ninety li west is Jiliang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Again three hundred li east of Khotan is Kancheng garrison; six hundred li east is Lancheng garrison; six hundred li south is Hunu garrison; two hundred li west is Gucheng garrison; three hundred ninety li west is Jiliang garrison.

sentences.zh: 于闐東距且末鎮千六百里。

translations.literal: East of Khotan to Qiemi garrison is one thousand six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: East of Khotan to Qiemi garrison is one thousand six hundred li.

sentences.zh: 自焉耆西五十里過鐵門關，又二十里至于術守捉城，又二百里至榆林守捉，又五十里至龍泉守捉，又六十里至東夷僻守捉，又七十里至西夷僻守捉，又六十里至赤岸守捉，又百二十里至安西都護府。

translations.literal: From Yanqi west fifty li passing Tiemen Pass, again twenty li to Yushu garrison city, again two hundred li to Yulin garrison, again fifty li to Longquan garrison, again sixty li to Dongyipi garrison, again seventy li to Xiyipi garrison, again sixty li to Chian garrison, again one hundred twenty li to the Anxi Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: From Yanqi west fifty li passing Tiemen Pass, again twenty li to Yushu garrison city, again two hundred li to Yulin garrison, again fifty li to Longquan garrison, again sixty li to Dongyipi garrison, again seventy li to Xiyipi garrison, again sixty li to Chian garrison, again one hundred twenty li to the Anxi Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 又一路自沙州壽昌縣西十里至陽關故城，又西至蒲昌海南岸千里。

translations.literal: Another route from Shazhou Shouchang County west ten li to Yangguan old city, again west to the south bank of the Puchang Sea one thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Another route from Shazhou Shouchang County west ten li to Yangguan old city, again west to the south bank of the Puchang Sea one thousand li.

sentences.zh: 自蒲昌海南岸，西經七屯城，漢伊脩城也。

translations.literal: From the Puchang Sea's south bank, west passing Qitun city—the Han Yixiu city.
translations.idiomatic: From the Puchang Sea's south bank, west passing Qitun city—the Han Yixiu city.

sentences.zh: 又西八十里至石城鎮，漢樓蘭國也，亦名鄯善，在蒲昌海南三百里，康豔典為鎮使以通西域者。

translations.literal: Again west eighty li to Shicheng garrison—the Han Loulan kingdom, also called Shanshan, three hundred li south of the Puchang Sea; Kang Yan was garrison commander to communicate with the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Again west eighty li to Shicheng garrison—the Han Loulan kingdom, also called Shanshan, three hundred li south of the Puchang Sea; Kang Yan was garrison commander to communicate with the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 又西二百里至新城，亦謂之弩支城，豔典所築。

translations.literal: Again west two hundred li to Xincheng—also called Nuzhi city, built by Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Again west two hundred li to Xincheng—also called Nuzhi city, built by Yan.

sentences.zh: 又西經特勒井，渡且末河，五百里至播仙鎮，故且末城也，高宗上元中更名。

translations.literal: Again west passing Tele well, crossing Qiemi River, five hundred li to Boxian garrison—the former Qiemi city, renamed in the Shangyuan era of Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Again west passing Tele well, crossing Qiemi River, five hundred li to Boxian garrison—the former Qiemi city, renamed in the Shangyuan era of Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 又西經悉利支井、祅井、勿遮水，五百里至于闐東蘭城守捉。

translations.literal: Again west passing Xilizhi well, Yao well, and Wuzhe water, five hundred li to Khotan's east Lancheng garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Again west passing Xilizhi well, Yao well, and Wuzhe water, five hundred li to Khotan's east Lancheng garrison.

sentences.zh: 又西經移杜堡、彭懷堡、坎城守捉，三百里至于闐。

translations.literal: Again west passing Yidu fort, Penghuai fort, and Kancheng garrison, three hundred li to Khotan.
translations.idiomatic: Again west passing Yidu fort, Penghuai fort, and Kancheng garrison, three hundred li to Khotan.

sentences.zh: 安南經交趾太平，百餘里至峯州。

translations.literal: From Annan through Jiaozhi Taiping, a hundred-odd li to Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: From Annan through Jiaozhi Taiping, a hundred-odd li to Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又經南田，百三十里至恩樓縣，乃水行四十里至忠城州。

translations.literal: Again passing Nantian, one hundred thirty li to Enlou County; then forty li by water to Zhongcheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Nantian, one hundred thirty li to Enlou County; then forty li by water to Zhongcheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又二百里至多利州，又三百里至朱貴州，又四百里至丹棠州，皆生獠也。

translations.literal: Again two hundred li to Duoli Prefecture, again three hundred li to Zhugui Prefecture, again four hundred li to Dantang Prefecture—all raw Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Again two hundred li to Duoli Prefecture, again three hundred li to Zhugui Prefecture, again four hundred li to Dantang Prefecture—all raw Liao.

sentences.zh: 又四百五十里至古湧步，水路距安南凡千五百五十里。

translations.literal: Again four hundred fifty li to ancient Yongbu; by water route from Annan in all one thousand five hundred fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: Again four hundred fifty li to ancient Yongbu; by water route from Annan in all one thousand five hundred fifty li.

sentences.zh: 又百八十里經浮動山、天井山，山上夾道皆天井，間不容跬者三十里。

translations.literal: Again one hundred eighty li passing Fudong Mountain and Tianjing Mountain—the mountains have sky-wells along the path, in places too narrow for half a pace for thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: Again one hundred eighty li passing Fudong Mountain and Tianjing Mountain—the mountains have sky-wells along the path, in places too narrow for half a pace for thirty li.

translations.literal: Two days' travel to Tangquan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Two days' travel to Tangquan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又五十里至祿索州，又十五里至龍武州，皆爨蠻安南境也。

translations.literal: Again fifty li to Luosuo Prefecture, again fifteen li to Longwu Prefecture—all Cuan Man Annan territory.
translations.idiomatic: Again fifty li to Luosuo Prefecture, again fifteen li to Longwu Prefecture—all Cuan Man Annan territory.

sentences.zh: 又八十三里至儻遲頓，又經八平城，八十里至洞澡水，又經南亭，百六十里至曲江，劍南地也。

translations.literal: Again eighty-three li to Tangchídun, again passing Baping city, eighty li to Dongzao water, again passing Nanting, one hundred sixty li to Qujiang—Jiannan territory.
translations.idiomatic: Again eighty-three li to Tangchídun, again passing Baping city, eighty li to Dongzao water, again passing Nanting, one hundred sixty li to Qujiang—Jiannan territory.

sentences.zh: 又經通海鎮，百六十里渡海河、利水至絳縣。

translations.literal: Again passing Tonghai garrison, one hundred sixty li crossing Haihe and Lishui to Jiang County.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Tonghai garrison, one hundred sixty li crossing Haihe and Lishui to Jiang County.

sentences.zh: 又八十里至晉寧驛，戎州地也。

translations.literal: Again eighty li to Jinning Post—Rong Prefecture territory.
translations.idiomatic: Again eighty li to Jinning Post—Rong Prefecture territory.

sentences.zh: 又八十里至柘東城，又八十里至安寧故城，又四百八十里至雲南城，又八十里至白崖城，又七十里至蒙舍城，又八十里至龍尾城，又十里至大和城，又二十五里至羊苴咩城。

translations.literal: Again eighty li to Zhedong city, again eighty li to Anning old city, again four hundred eighty li to Yunnan city, again eighty li to Baiya city, again seventy li to Mengshe city, again eighty li to Longwei city, again ten li to Dahe city, again twenty-five li to Yangjumie city.
translations.idiomatic: Again eighty li to Zhedong city, again eighty li to Anning old city, again four hundred eighty li to Yunnan city, again eighty li to Baiya city, again seventy li to Mengshe city, again eighty li to Longwei city, again ten li to Dahe city, again twenty-five li to Yangjumie city.

sentences.zh: 自羊苴咩城西至永昌故郡三百里。

translations.literal: From Yangjumie city west to Yongchang old commandery is three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: From Yangjumie city west to Yongchang old commandery is three hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又西渡怒江，至諸葛亮城二百里。

translations.literal: Again west crossing the Nu River to Zhuge Liang city is two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again west crossing the Nu River to Zhuge Liang city is two hundred li.

translations.literal: Again south to Le city is two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again south to Le city is two hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又入驃國境，經萬公等八部落，至悉利城七百里。

translations.literal: Again entering Pyu territory, passing eight tribes including Wangong, to Xili city is seven hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again entering Pyu territory, passing eight tribes including Wangong, to Xili city is seven hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又經突旻城至驃國千里。

translations.literal: Again passing Tumin city to Pyu is one thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Tumin city to Pyu is one thousand li.

sentences.zh: 又自驃國西度黑山，至東天竺迦摩波國千六百里。

translations.literal: Again from Pyu west crossing Black Mountain to East Tianzhu Kampos kingdom is one thousand six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again from Pyu west crossing Black Mountain to East Tianzhu Kampos kingdom is one thousand six hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又西北渡迦羅都河至奔那伐檀那國六百里。

translations.literal: Again northwest crossing the Karot River to Banabhuvarna kingdom is six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest crossing the Karot River to Banabhuvarna kingdom is six hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又西南至中天竺國東境恆河南岸羯朱嗢羅國四百里。

translations.literal: Again southwest to Middle Tianzhu kingdom's east border south bank of the Ganges at Kajurapura kingdom is four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again southwest to Middle Tianzhu kingdom's east border south bank of the Ganges at Kajurapura kingdom is four hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又西至摩羯陀國六百里。

translations.literal: Again west to Magadha kingdom is six hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again west to Magadha kingdom is six hundred li.

sentences.zh: 一路自諸葛亮城西去騰充城二百里。

translations.literal: One route from Zhuge Liang city west to Tengchong city is two hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: One route from Zhuge Liang city west to Tengchong city is two hundred li.

translations.literal: Again west to Mi city one hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Again west to Mi city one hundred li.

sentences.zh: 又西過山，二百里至麗水城。

translations.literal: Again west crossing mountains, two hundred li to Lishui city.
translations.idiomatic: Again west crossing mountains, two hundred li to Lishui city.

sentences.zh: 乃西渡麗水、龍泉水，二百里至安西城。

translations.literal: Then west crossing Lishui and Longquan water, two hundred li to Anxi city.
translations.idiomatic: Then west crossing Lishui and Longquan water, two hundred li to Anxi city.

sentences.zh: 乃西渡彌諾江水，千里至大秦婆羅門國。

translations.literal: Then west crossing Minuo River water, one thousand li to Great Qin Brahmana kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Then west crossing Minuo River water, one thousand li to Great Qin Brahmana kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又西渡大嶺，三百里至東天竺北界箇沒盧國。

translations.literal: Again west crossing Great Ridge, three hundred li to East Tianzhu north border Gemo kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again west crossing Great Ridge, three hundred li to East Tianzhu north border Gemo kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又西南千二百里，至中天竺國東北境之奔那伐檀那國，與驃國往婆羅門路合。

translations.literal: Again southwest one thousand two hundred li to Middle Tianzhu kingdom northeast border Banabhuvarna kingdom, joining the Pyu-to-Brahmana route.
translations.idiomatic: Again southwest one thousand two hundred li to Middle Tianzhu kingdom northeast border Banabhuvarna kingdom, joining the Pyu-to-Brahmana route.

sentences.zh: 一路自驩州東二日行，至唐林州安遠縣，南行經古羅江，二日行至環王國之檀洞江。

translations.literal: One route from Huan Prefecture east two days' travel to Tanglin Prefecture Anyuan County; south passing ancient Luo River, two days' travel to Huanwang kingdom's Tandong River.
translations.idiomatic: One route from Huan Prefecture east two days' travel to Tanglin Prefecture Anyuan County; south passing ancient Luo River, two days' travel to Huanwang kingdom's Tandong River.

sentences.zh: 又四日至朱崖，又經單補鎮，二日至環王國城，故漢日南郡地也。

translations.literal: Again four days to Zhuyai, again passing Danbu garrison, two days to Huanwang kingdom city—former Han Rinan commandery territory.
translations.idiomatic: Again four days to Zhuyai, again passing Danbu garrison, two days to Huanwang kingdom city—former Han Rinan commandery territory.

sentences.zh: 自驩州西南三日行，度霧溫嶺，又二日行至棠州日落縣，又經羅倫江及古朗洞之石蜜山，三日行至棠州文陽縣。

translations.literal: From Huan Prefecture southwest three days' travel, crossing Wuwun Ridge, again two days to Tang Prefecture Riluo County, again passing Luolun River and ancient Langdong's Shimi Mountain, three days to Tang Prefecture Wenyang County.
translations.idiomatic: From Huan Prefecture southwest three days' travel, crossing Wuwun Ridge, again two days to Tang Prefecture Riluo County, again passing Luolun River and ancient Langdong's Shimi Mountain, three days to Tang Prefecture Wenyang County.

sentences.zh: 又經漦漦澗，四日行至文單國之算臺縣，又三日行至文單外城，又一日行至內城，一曰陸真臘，其南水真臘。

translations.literal: Again passing Xixi Stream, four days to Wendant kingdom's Suantai County, again three days to Wendant outer city, again one day to inner city—also called Land Chenla; south of it is Water Chenla.
translations.idiomatic: Again passing Xixi Stream, four days to Wendant kingdom's Suantai County, again three days to Wendant outer city, again one day to inner city—also called Land Chenla; south of it is Water Chenla.

sentences.zh: 又南至小海，其南羅越國，又南至大海。

translations.literal: Again south to a small sea; south of it is Luoyue kingdom, again south to the great sea.
translations.idiomatic: Again south to a small sea; south of it is Luoyue kingdom, again south to the great sea.

sentences.zh: 廣州東南海行，二百里至屯門山，乃帆風西行，二日至九州石。

translations.literal: From Guangzhou southeast by sea, two hundred li to Tunmen Mountain; then with favorable wind sailing west, two days to Jiuzhou Rock.
translations.idiomatic: From Guangzhou southeast by sea, two hundred li to Tunmen Mountain; then with favorable wind sailing west, two days to Jiuzhou Rock.

translations.literal: Again south two days to Xiangshi.
translations.idiomatic: Again south two days to Xiangshi.

sentences.zh: 又西南三日行，至占不勞山，山在環王國東二百里海中。

translations.literal: Again southwest three days' travel to Zhanbulao Mountain—the mountain is two hundred li east of Huanwang kingdom in the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Again southwest three days' travel to Zhanbulao Mountain—the mountain is two hundred li east of Huanwang kingdom in the sea.

translations.literal: Again south two days to Lingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Again south two days to Lingshan.

translations.literal: Again one day's travel to Mendu kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again one day's travel to Mendu kingdom.

translations.literal: Again one day's travel to Guda kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again one day's travel to Guda kingdom.

translations.literal: Again half a day's travel to Bentuolang Continent.
translations.idiomatic: Again half a day's travel to Bentuolang Continent.

translations.literal: Again two days to Juntuong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Again two days to Juntuong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又五日行至海硤，蕃人謂之「質」，南北百里，北岸則羅越國，南岸則佛逝國，佛逝國東水行四五日，至訶陵國，南中洲之最大者。

translations.literal: Again five days to the sea strait—the fan call it "Zhi"; north and south one hundred li; on the north bank is Luoyue kingdom, on the south bank is Foshi kingdom; from Foshi kingdom east by water four or five days to Heling kingdom—the greatest state in the southern islands.
translations.idiomatic: Again five days to the sea strait—the fan call it "Zhi"; north and south one hundred li; on the north bank is Luoyue kingdom, on the south bank is Foshi kingdom; from Foshi kingdom east by water four or five days to Heling kingdom—the greatest state in the southern islands.

sentences.zh: 又西出硤，三日至葛葛僧祇國，在佛逝西北隅之別島，國人多鈔暴，乘舶者畏憚之。

translations.literal: Again west out of the strait, three days to Gegesengqi kingdom—a separate island northwest of Foshi; the people are much given to piracy and those traveling by ship fear them.
translations.idiomatic: Again west out of the strait, three days to Gegesengqi kingdom—a separate island northwest of Foshi; the people are much given to piracy and those traveling by ship fear them.

translations.literal: On its north bank is Jieluo kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: On its north bank is Jieluo kingdom.

translations.literal: West of Jieluo is Gegeguo kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: West of Jieluo is Gegeguo kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又從葛葛僧祇四五日行，至勝鄧洲。

translations.literal: Again from Gegesengqi four or five days' travel to Shengdeng Continent.
translations.idiomatic: Again from Gegesengqi four or five days' travel to Shengdeng Continent.

translations.literal: Again west five days' travel to Bolu kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again west five days' travel to Bolu kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又六日行，至婆國伽藍洲。

translations.literal: Again six days' travel to Boguo Galan Continent.
translations.idiomatic: Again six days' travel to Boguo Galan Continent.

sentences.zh: 又北四日行，至師子國，其北海岸距南天竺大岸百里。

translations.literal: Again north four days' travel to Shizi kingdom; its north coast is one hundred li from South Tianzhu's great shore.
translations.idiomatic: Again north four days' travel to Shizi kingdom; its north coast is one hundred li from South Tianzhu's great shore.

sentences.zh: 又西四日行，經沒來國，南天竺之最南境。

translations.literal: Again west four days' travel, passing Meilai kingdom—South Tianzhu's southernmost border.
translations.idiomatic: Again west four days' travel, passing Meilai kingdom—South Tianzhu's southernmost border.

sentences.zh: 又西北經十餘小國，至婆羅門西境。

translations.literal: Again northwest passing more than ten small kingdoms to Brahmana west border.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest passing more than ten small kingdoms to Brahmana west border.

sentences.zh: 又西北二日行，至拔䫻國。

translations.literal: Again northwest two days' travel to Bafu kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest two days' travel to Bafu kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又十日行，經天竺西境小國五，至提䫻國，其國有彌蘭太河，一曰新頭河，自北渤崑國來，西流至提䫻國北，入于海。

translations.literal: Again ten days' travel, passing five small kingdoms on Tianzhu's west border, to Tifu kingdom; that kingdom has the Milan River—also called Xintou River—coming from North Bohun kingdom in the west, flowing west to Tifu kingdom's north and entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Again ten days' travel, passing five small kingdoms on Tianzhu's west border, to Tifu kingdom; that kingdom has the Milan River—also called Xintou River—coming from North Bohun kingdom in the west, flowing west to Tifu kingdom's north and entering the sea.

sentences.zh: 又自提䫻國西二十日行，經小國二十餘，至提羅盧和國，一曰羅和異國，國人於海中立華表，夜則置炬其上，使舶人夜行不迷。

translations.literal: Again from Tifu kingdom west twenty days' travel, passing more than twenty small kingdoms, to Tiluhe kingdom—also called Luoheyi kingdom; the people set up ornamental columns in the sea, and at night place torches on them so ships travel by night without losing their way.
translations.idiomatic: Again from Tifu kingdom west twenty days' travel, passing more than twenty small kingdoms, to Tiluhe kingdom—also called Luoheyi kingdom; the people set up ornamental columns in the sea, and at night place torches on them so ships travel by night without losing their way.

sentences.zh: 又西一日行，至烏剌國，乃大食國之弗利剌河，南入于海。

translations.literal: Again west one day's travel to Wula kingdom—the Dashi kingdom's Fulila River, flowing south into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Again west one day's travel to Wula kingdom—the Dashi kingdom's Fulila River, flowing south into the sea.

sentences.zh: 小舟泝流，二日至末羅國，大食重鎮也。

translations.literal: By small craft upstream, two days to Moluo kingdom—a Dashi stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: By small craft upstream, two days to Moluo kingdom—a Dashi stronghold.

sentences.zh: 又西北陸行千里，至茂門王所都縛達城。

translations.literal: Again northwest overland one thousand li to Maomen King's capital Fuda city.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest overland one thousand li to Maomen King's capital Fuda city.

sentences.zh: 自婆羅門南境，從沒來國至烏剌國，皆緣海東岸行；

translations.literal: From Brahmana south border, from Meilai kingdom to Wula kingdom, all travel along the sea's east bank;
translations.idiomatic: From Brahmana south border, from Meilai kingdom to Wula kingdom, all travel along the sea's east bank;

sentences.zh: 其西岸之西，皆大食國，其西最南謂之三蘭國。

translations.literal: on its west bank's west all is Dashi kingdom; its westernmost south is called the Sanlan kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: on its west bank's west all is Dashi kingdom; its westernmost south is called the Sanlan kingdom.

sentences.zh: 自三蘭國正北二十日行，經小國十餘，至設國。

translations.literal: From Sanlan kingdom due north twenty days' travel, passing more than ten small kingdoms, to She kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: From Sanlan kingdom due north twenty days' travel, passing more than ten small kingdoms, to She kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又十日行，經小國六七，至薩伊瞿和竭國，當海西岸。

translations.literal: Again ten days' travel, passing six or seven small kingdoms, to Sayihejie kingdom, on the sea's west bank.
translations.idiomatic: Again ten days' travel, passing six or seven small kingdoms, to Sayihejie kingdom, on the sea's west bank.

sentences.zh: 又西六七日行，經小國六七，至沒巽國。

translations.literal: Again west six or seven days' travel, passing six or seven small kingdoms, to Moxun kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again west six or seven days' travel, passing six or seven small kingdoms, to Moxun kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又西北十日行，經小國十餘，至拔離謌磨難國。

translations.literal: Again northwest ten days' travel, passing more than ten small kingdoms, to Baligemo kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Again northwest ten days' travel, passing more than ten small kingdoms, to Baligemo kingdom.

sentences.zh: 又一日行，至烏剌國，與東岸路合。

translations.literal: Again one day's travel to Wula kingdom, joining the east-bank route.
translations.idiomatic: Again one day's travel to Wula kingdom, joining the east-bank route.

sentences.zh: 西域有陀拔思單國，在疏勒西南二萬五千里，東距勃達國，西至涅滿國，皆一月行，南至羅剎支國半月行，北至海兩月行。

translations.literal: In the Western Regions is Tuobasidan kingdom, twenty-five thousand li southwest of Shule; east one month's travel to Boda kingdom, west one month's travel to Nieman kingdom, south half a month's travel to Luoshazhi kingdom, north two months' travel to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the Western Regions is Tuobasidan kingdom, twenty-five thousand li southwest of Shule; east one month's travel to Boda kingdom, west one month's travel to Nieman kingdom, south half a month's travel to Luoshazhi kingdom, north two months' travel to the sea.

sentences.zh: 羅剎支國東至都槃國半月行，西至沙蘭國，南至大食國皆二十日行。

translations.literal: Luoshazhi kingdom east half a month's travel to Dupan kingdom, west to Shalan kingdom, south to Dashi kingdom—all twenty days' travel.
translations.idiomatic: Luoshazhi kingdom east half a month's travel to Dupan kingdom, west to Shalan kingdom, south to Dashi kingdom—all twenty days' travel.

sentences.zh: 都槃國東至大食國半月行，南至大食國二十五日行，北至勃達國一月行。

translations.literal: Dupan kingdom east half a month's travel to Dashi kingdom, south twenty-five days' travel to Dashi kingdom, north one month's travel to Boda kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Dupan kingdom east half a month's travel to Dashi kingdom, south twenty-five days' travel to Dashi kingdom, north one month's travel to Boda kingdom.

sentences.zh: 勃達國東至大食國兩月行，西北至岐蘭國二十日行，北至大食國一月行。

translations.literal: Boda kingdom east two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, northwest twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom, north one month's travel to Dashi kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Boda kingdom east two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, northwest twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom, north one month's travel to Dashi kingdom.

sentences.zh: 河沒國東南至陀拔國半月行，西北至岐蘭國二十日行，南至沙蘭國一月行，北至海兩月行。

translations.literal: Hemei kingdom southeast half a month's travel to Tuoba kingdom, northwest twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom, south one month's travel to Shalan kingdom, north two months' travel to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hemei kingdom southeast half a month's travel to Tuoba kingdom, northwest twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom, south one month's travel to Shalan kingdom, north two months' travel to the sea.

sentences.zh: 岐蘭國西至大食國兩月行，南至涅滿國二十日行，北至海五日行。

translations.literal: Qilan kingdom west two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, south twenty days' travel to Nieman kingdom, north five days' travel to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Qilan kingdom west two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, south twenty days' travel to Nieman kingdom, north five days' travel to the sea.

sentences.zh: 涅滿國西至大食國兩月行，南至大食國一月行，北至岐蘭國二十日行。

translations.literal: Nieman kingdom west two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, south one month's travel to Dashi kingdom, north twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Nieman kingdom west two months' travel to Dashi kingdom, south one month's travel to Dashi kingdom, north twenty days' travel to Qilan kingdom.

sentences.zh: 沙蘭國南至大食國二十五日行，北至涅滿國二十五日行。

translations.literal: Shalan kingdom south twenty-five days' travel to Dashi kingdom, north twenty-five days' travel to Nieman kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Shalan kingdom south twenty-five days' travel to Dashi kingdom, north twenty-five days' travel to Nieman kingdom.

sentences.zh: 石國東至拔汗那國百里，西南至東米國五百里。

translations.literal: Shi kingdom east one hundred li to Bahana kingdom, southwest five hundred li to Dongmi kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Shi kingdom east one hundred li to Bahana kingdom, southwest five hundred li to Dongmi kingdom.

sentences.zh: 罽賓國在疏勒西南四千里，東至俱蘭城國七百里，西至大食國千里，南至婆羅門國五百里，北至吐火羅國二百里。

translations.literal: Kapisa kingdom is four thousand li southwest of Shule; east seven hundred li to Julan city kingdom, west one thousand li to Dashi kingdom, south five hundred li to Brahmana kingdom, north two hundred li to Tuhuoluo kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Kapisa kingdom is four thousand li southwest of Shule; east seven hundred li to Julan city kingdom, west one thousand li to Dashi kingdom, south five hundred li to Brahmana kingdom, north two hundred li to Tuhuoluo kingdom.

sentences.zh: 東米國在安國西北二千里，東至碎葉國五千里，西南至石國千五百里，南至拔汗那國千五百里。

translations.literal: Dongmi kingdom is two thousand li northwest of An kingdom; east five thousand li to Suyab kingdom, southwest one thousand five hundred li to Shi kingdom, south one thousand five hundred li to Bahana kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Dongmi kingdom is two thousand li northwest of An kingdom; east five thousand li to Suyab kingdom, southwest one thousand five hundred li to Shi kingdom, south one thousand five hundred li to Bahana kingdom.

sentences.zh: 史國在疏勒西二千里，東至俱蜜國千里，西至大食國二千里，南至吐火羅國二百里，西北至康國七百里。

translations.literal: Shi kingdom is two thousand li west of Shule; east one thousand li to Jumi kingdom, west two thousand li to Dashi kingdom, south two hundred li to Tuhuoluo kingdom, northwest seven hundred li to Kang kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Shi kingdom is two thousand li west of Shule; east one thousand li to Jumi kingdom, west two thousand li to Dashi kingdom, south two hundred li to Tuhuoluo kingdom, northwest seven hundred li to Kang kingdom.
